input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance provision anywhere: Sections 1-9 cover services, fees, term, site management, exclusivity, cross-promotions, confidentiality and warranties, and the General Provisions (Sections 10.1-10.8) end with notices, no joint venture, assignment, waiver, governing law, severability, survival, entire agreement and headings. HDI hosts the Site and, under Section 8.1, has access to Content, user information and data of the Company, so the playbook expects insurance and its absence is walk-away territory. We therefore insert a new Section 10.9 at the preferred level (CGL $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate, E&O $2M, cyber and privacy $5M where HDI processes our data, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request), with the fallback (E&O $1M / cyber $2M) available in negotiation.

proposal.summary: Insert a new Section 10.9 requiring HDI to carry CGL, E&O, cyber/privacy and workers' compensation coverage and to provide certificates on request.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] HDI hosts the Site and processes our data, so we added a standard insurance provision (CGL $1M/$2M, E&O $2M, cyber/privacy $5M where our data is processed, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request). We can accept a fallback of E&O $1M and cyber $2M if needed.

ops.text: Insurance. HDI shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence and $2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than $2,000,000; where HDI processes any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for the Company, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than $5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by law. HDI shall provide certificates of insurance to the Company on request.
